image_description: A hammerhead shark swimming in deep blue water, viewed from above and slightly behind. The shark's distinctive hammer-shaped head (cephalofoil) is visible, with eyes at the lateral tips. The body is streamlined with visible dorsal and pectoral fins. The caudal fin is partially visible. The image has a greenish-blue tint typical of underwater photography.
